title: King of Pickaxe
description:
🪓 King of PickaxeBecome the pickaxe. Show no mercy.

The King of Pickaxe has arrived...
It's time to massacre the cute and innocent pebbles.
Crush their little dreams as they desperately struggle to survive!

You control a living, breathing pickaxe.
Move your mouse to dodge, swing it to smash.
This is a cursor-based roguelike — fully playable with just your mouse.

🧱 Key Features

🔸 Cursor-Based Roguelike Action
Dodge by moving the mouse, attack by swinging it!
Fast, intuitive combat with only one tool: your cursor.

🔸 Deck-Building System
Mix and match skills and upgrades to build your own destructive deck.
Chain together devastating combos and evolve your pickaxe into a true killing machine.

🔸 Adorable... but destined for destruction
The pebbles are small, kind, and harmless.
Too bad — they’re nothing but targets to you.

🔸 Endless Replayability
New upgrades, new decks, new chaos — every run is different.
Unlock fresh strategies and face new challenges each time you play.

Become the true king of pickaxes,
and wipe them all out.
description_short: Boom Boom Boom! Make way for the King of Pickaxe! The ultimate pebble-massacring roguelike is here. King of Pickaxe lets you move with your mouse cursor and swing to crush waves of kind and innocent little rocks. No mercy. Just pure destruction — one swing at a time.
